title: CelesTrak Current GP Element Sets
note: Provides constellation groups including Starlink, OneWeb, Qianfan, Hulianwang and Kuiper.

title: A New Way to Obtain GP Data
note: Documents GP queries and CCSDS OMM formats. Group results are catalog objects, not an operator-certified operational fleet count.

title: Space-Track SATCAT data model
note: Authenticated reference for NORAD catalog identifiers and CURRENT status. Useful for object-level review; automated access requires a Space-Track account.

title: Online Index of Objects Launched into Outer Space
publisher: United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs
note: Registration and identity cross-check for functional space objects. Registration lag means it is not suitable as the primary live fleet counter.

title: SpaceX EU Prospectus
note: States approximately 9,600 Starlink broadband and mobile satellites as of March 31, 2026.

title: FCC Approves Next-Gen Satellite Constellation
note: Authorizes an additional 7,500 Gen2 satellites, bringing the authorized total referenced by FCC to 15,000.

title: OneWeb LEO Constellation
note: Describes 600+ satellites in 12 orbital planes at about 1,200 km.

title: Eutelsat and MaiaSpace launch agreement
note: Future OneWeb LEO launch agreement starting in 2027.

title: Amazon Leo mission updates
note: LA-08 brought the total deployed to 396 satellites; initial service rollout planned for 2026.

title: Amazon Q2 2026 Results
note: Reports nearly 400 Amazon Leo satellites in orbit and initial service expected in 2026.

title: Telesat expands Lightspeed network to 225 satellites
note: Expands the Lightspeed network to 225 satellites; global service delivery remains targeted for Q1 2028.

title: Telesat 2025 results
note: Telesat continued to expect the first Lightspeed satellites to launch in late 2026.

title: Qianfan constellation satellites reach 218
note: MIIT states 218 Qianfan satellites had been launched.

title: Qianfan constellation overview
note: States a long-term plan of more than 15,000 satellites.

title: SatNet LEO Group 24 launch notice
publisher: National Space Facilities Control and Test Center of Ukraine
note: Reports 9 spacecraft in Group 24 and 186 identified spacecraft in the constellation at that time.

title: IRIS² – EU Secure Connectivity Programme
note: 348 satellites total: 330 LEO and 18 MEO; first launches in 2029 and initial governmental services in 2030.

title: Telesat contracts MDA as prime satellite manufacturer for Lightspeed
note: 2023 baseline: launches scheduled to commence in mid-2026 and global service in late 2027.

title: Telesat adds military Ka-band to Lightspeed
note: States the first two production satellites will launch in December 2026, followed by a high-cadence 2027 campaign.
